visualCharacteristics: Default: auto-fill grid of bordered image + body cards. "spotlight": background photo header with vertical icon list. "grid": grey section, text header row, boxed cards with CTA. "showcase": centered header and borderless centered cards. "feature": white, text header row then a borderless 4-up row of rounded photo, H3 and description items with no links.
contentPattern: Rows of [picture] | [h3, p, optional link]. spotlight: first row [background picture] | [heading, intro]. grid/showcase/feature: first row is a text-only header [h2].
